description: Ships moving through the world's straits and canals (Suez, Panama, Malacca, Hormuz and others) and ports, from the IMF's PortWatch, which estimates them from satellite tracking of ships. All chokepoints against a year ago, one chokepoint by week, or one port. No key.

chokepoint.description: A strait or canal, such as Suez Canal, Panama Canal, Malacca Strait or Strait of Hormuz. Without chokepoint or port you get every chokepoint.

end.description: Last day; default today, and the data runs a week or more behind.

port.description: A port by name, such as Shanghai or Rotterdam.

start.description: First day; default about 100 days before the last.

name: shipping_activity
title: Shipping activity (IMF PortWatch)
